title: נחום הלבלר

paragraphs: Naḥum the lavlar, meaning scribe, R. Meyasha's student. Tanḥuma, Bamidbar, has R. Tanḥum the scribe in R. Meyasha's name (see his entry, that he received from the elders). In the last generation of the Second Temple. Pe'ah 2:6 places him in Rabban Gamliel the elder's days, in the Chamber of Hewn Stone, at least forty years before the Temple's destruction, as HaYu Vodekin states.
